nodes.description: Public mapping of user balances; mutated by transferFrom and batchSend without SafeMath.
Public nested mapping of spender allowances; mutated by approve and transferFrom.
Total token supply set once in the constructor.
Privileged owner address set to msg.sender in the constructor; guards delegate and batchSend.
Token name string assigned in constructor.
Token symbol string assigned in constructor.
Constant public decimals value of 18.
Constant internal Uniswap router address pre-approved in the constructor.
Payable constructor that mints supply to msg.sender, sets owner and grants unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom using msg.sender as source.
Public payable transfer guarded by the ensure modifier; performs unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic.
Public payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] unconditionally.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a user-supplied address with user-supplied calldata.
Owner-only batch transfer that multiplies _value by array length without SafeMath and credits balances unchecked.
Modifier that recomputes the Uniswap pair and restricts transferFrom to owner or pair participants.
Internal pure helper computing a Uniswap V2 pair address via CREATE2 keccak hashing.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, ownership and balance accounting.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) executing arbitrary external code in the contract storage context.
Unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length allowing integer overflow.
Raw += and -= balance/allowance arithmetic with no SafeMath or overflow checks.
Constructor token name argument.
Constructor token symbol argument.
Constructor initial supply argument.
Destination address argument of transfer.
Amount argument of transfer, forwarded unchecked.
Source address argument of transferFrom, validated by ensure.
Destination address argument of transferFrom, validated by ensure.
Amount argument of transferFrom used in unchecked subtraction.
Spender address argument of approve.
Allowance amount argument of approve.
Arbitrary target address of the delegatecall in delegate.
Arbitrary calldata bytes passed to delegatecall in delegate.
Recipient array of batchSend used in the length multiplication.
Per-recipient amount of batchSend used in unchecked multiplication.
Modifier argument checking the transfer source against owner or UNI pair.
Modifier argument checking the transfer destination against owner.
Uniswap factory address input of pairFor.
First token address input of pairFor.
Second token address input of pairFor.
Local pair address computed inside the ensure modifier for the access check.
Local variable holding the overflow-prone _value * _tos.length product in batchSend.
Loop counter of batchSend iterating over _tos.
Loop-local recipient copied from _tos[i] and credited in batchSend.
Sorted lower address local used in pairFor hashing.
Sorted higher address local used in pairFor hashing.
Local pair address returned by pairFor from CREATE2 computation.

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the _from argument of transferFrom inside transfer.
msg.sender is read to validate spender allowance in transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner key in approve.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before performing delegatecall.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner and uses msg.sender balance.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints the whole supply to msg.sender.
owner state variable gates the delegate delegatecall.
owner state variable gates batchSend.
ensure modifier restricts transferFrom from/to addresses to owner or the UNI pair.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the allowed Uniswap pair address.
User-supplied address a is the target of the low-level delegatecall.
User-supplied calldata b is executed by the delegatecall.
delegate performs an arbitrary external delegatecall enabling state hijack and callbacks.
Delegatecall executes in this contract context and can arbitrarily rewrite balanceOf.
Delegatecall can overwrite the owner storage slot and seize access control.
_tos.length participates in the unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length.
_value participates in the unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length.
Product of _value and array length is stored in local total with no overflow check.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath.
Local total is used to debit msg.sender balance in batchSend.
transfer amount reaches unchecked balance arithmetic through transferFrom.
transferFrom amount is subtracted from balances and allowance without SafeMath.
transferFrom performs raw -= and += updates on balanceOf and allowance.
batchSend performs raw -= and += updates on balanceOf.
transfer unconditionally forwards to transferFrom.
transfer destination _to is forwarded to transferFrom.
_from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
_to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
ensure modifier argument _from is compared against owner and the UNI pair.
ensure modifier argument _to is compared against owner.
Local UNI pair address is used in the ensure access check.
_spender keys the allowance mapping in approve.
_value is written verbatim into the allowance mapping in approve.
transferFrom reads and debits the allowance mapping.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
batchSend reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
Loop-local recipient _to is credited in balanceOf with no overflow protection.
Loop counter i drives the batchSend transfer loop.
Array element _tos[i] is copied into the loop-local recipient.
factory address is hashed into the CREATE2 pair computation.
tokenA is sorted and hashed in pairFor.
tokenB is sorted and hashed in pairFor.
Local token0 participates in the pair address hash.
Local token1 participates in the pair address hash.
Local pair is the computed CREATE2 address returned by pairFor.
Constructor name argument is assigned to the name state variable.
Constructor symbol argument is assigned to the symbol state variable.
Constructor supply argument initializes totalSupply and the owner balance.
Constructor sets totalSupply from the supplied value.
Constructor grants the UNI router unlimited allowance.
